_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: McGraw Hill Financial 'is a leading benchmarks & ratings, analytics, data and research provider serving the global capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: McGraw Hill Financial 'is a leading benchmarks & ratings, analytics, data and research provider serving the global capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.58x; +11% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.41; conservative 2yr +26%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -39.1%/yr (worst year FY05-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.9%/yr (Q4 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +9.9%/yr (FY05-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MHFI (retrospective, 2016-02-05) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.58x (68.5% downside to Bear $27 / +43.4% upside to Bull $123) | Adj composite 2.82 vs market 2.41: gap +0.41 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +11% above the EPP floor $77 (17x FY16E $4.53) | Conservative 2-yr case: +26.4% total (+13.2%/yr) | At 18.9x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $113 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Financial Services revenue +5.3% in Q4 2015, forward revenues +6.5% (no FY16 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2015 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
